lead_raw_text:
The cubic phase HoAl4Cu (space group F-43m, No. 216) has a unit cell containing 24 atoms—Ho4Al16Cu4—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers with 12 geometric neighbors (8 Al, 2 Cu, 2 Ho) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while both Cu and Ho centers have 16 neighbors each. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Al-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Al and Cu or Ho 16-vertex polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D component spanning all 24 sites.
